workspace_entitlements_period_order_chec.name: workspace_entitlements_period_order_check
workspace_entitlements_period_order_chec.value: "workspace_entitlements"."current_period_started_at" IS NULL OR "workspace_entitlements"."current_period_ends_at" IS NULL OR "workspace_entitlements"."current_period_started_at" <= "workspace_entitlements"."current_period_ends_at"

workspace_entitlements_pending_plan_pair.name: workspace_entitlements_pending_plan_pair_check
workspace_entitlements_pending_plan_pair.value: ("workspace_entitlements"."pending_plan_key" IS NULL AND "workspace_entitlements"."pending_plan_effective_at" IS NULL) OR ("workspace_entitlements"."pending_plan_key" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_entitlements"."pending_plan_effective_at" IS NOT NULL)

billing_transactions_vat_consistency_che.name: billing_transactions_vat_consistency_check
billing_transactions_vat_consistency_che.value:
(
        NOT "billing_transactions"."vat_enabled"
        AND "billing_transactions"."applied_vat_rate_basis_points" = 0
        AND "billing_transactions"."vat_amount_minor" = 0
        AND "billing_transactions"."tax_mode" = 'disabled'
      ) OR (
        "billing_transactions"."vat_enabled"
        AND "billing_transactions"."tax_mode" = 'exclusive'
      )
